subject: general
question: Seven boxes A, B, C, D, E, F and G are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order. No box is kept above G. Only three boxes are kept between G and B. Only one box is kept between F and D. D is kept immediately above B. Only four boxes are kept between F and E. A is kept at some place above C. How many boxes are kept above B?
solution:
Seven boxes A, B, C, D, E, F and G are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order.

 
• No box is kept above G.
 
• Only three boxes are kept between G and B.
 
• Only one box is kept between F and D.
 
• D is kept immediately above B.
 
• Only four boxes are kept between F and E.
 
• A is kept at some place above C

The Final Arrangement is,

 
 

 
 
G

 
 
 

 
 
F

 
 
 

 
 
A

 
 
 

 
 
D

 
 
 

 
 
B

 
 
 

 
 
C

 
 
 

 
 
E

 
 
 

 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**
